VENICE IN NORWAY。

A large number of Norwegian fishing villages situated in the fjords regions have many things in common with the "City of Lagoons" - Vanice. The inhabitants in order to visit each other or to do their shopping in the village are obliged to use small boats which is their only means of travel. It is rather a unique sight to see the peasant girls dressed in their Sunday attire, going to church in small boats.
